hooks.name: spec-trace
hooks.description: After saving generator code, require traceability to spec requirements/properties and a matching test.

action.prompt: A file under src/page888/ was just saved. Using .kiro/specs/page888/ (requirements.md, design.md, tasks.md), state which requirement numbers (e.g. R6.4) and which design property numbers this change implements. Then add or update the matching test in tests/test_<module>.py (property tests named test_prop_*; no network, use tests/fixtures/). If no requirement or property covers the change, say so and propose a spec update instead of silently proceeding. Keep stdlib-only runtime.
